decisions.reason: The system layout and CAD must represent the client-mandated front, customer-facing placard placement, but the existing same-message MODIFY omits these constraints.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.

value_updates.layout_constraint: Represent the accepted solenoid valve directly beneath the bowl as part of the button-controlled dispensing path.

decisions.reason: Moving the existing branded placard from the back to the front changes its layout placement but does not necessarily change component selection or the bill of materials.
The placard's physical position and viewing orientation do not change the electrical wiring plan or its required coverage.
